objective: Fix The Word Android status-bar overlap and accurately explain the empty state when no Word has been published for the current week.
productionBaselineEvidence: DEV-only source change based on main; no production artifact or live fingerprint changed.
chosenApproach: Use the existing react-native-safe-area-context inset on the screen container, clarify the weekly empty-state copy, and add a focused source-contract regression test.
selectionRationale: The screen is a root route whose shared.screen container does not reserve the top system inset. The live devotionals table currently has no published rows for Nov 2–6, 2026, so the current-week empty state is correct and must not be fabricated away.
acceptanceChecks: The Word content starts below the Android status bar using the device top safe-area inset.
The empty state explicitly says no Word has been published this week while retaining Previous Words.
The existing current-week selection, daily archive, membership gate, detail route, offline cache, and Supabase security remain unchanged.
preserveBehaviors: Existing devotionals table and admin publish_date/is_published controls.
Existing Monday-start week selection and newest-first archive.
Existing Cluster membership gate and account-scoped offline cache.
No database schema, RLS, authentication, or production OTA changes.
alternativeApproaches: Apply a fixed pixel top padding; rejected because status-bar height varies by device, display cutout, and system configuration.
Wrap the route in a new nested SafeAreaView; rejected because the existing safe-area context already exposes the exact top inset and a local container adjustment is smaller.
